answer: The cornerstone is Signalman block token shift record stamped by the signal office. Lay it as each block token is a dated duty entry plus a signed box log, so a farm must work 7 and the whole wall stands on real work. A farm that wants 754 seats must buy 754 tickets at 92 POA each, a 69368 POA outlay for one epoch. One relic per identity, one canyon per alias, one ember per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. A farm cannot borrow a history, rent a credential, or forge a calendar.
